metadata.name: fmt2-r630-rocky10-kolla-node-prep
metadata.description: Define the Rocky Linux 10 node-prep contract for FMT2 R630 Kolla hosts before any OpenStack deployment or destructive rebuild.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible root containing FMT2 Kolla inventory and preflight playbooks.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory containing pri/sec/ter/deployer Kolla host roles.

variables.name: kolla_hosts
variables.description: Initial R630 hosts to validate for Rocky Linux 10 Kolla node prep.

variables.name: target_os
variables.description: Required first-pass OpenStack node operating system.

variables.name: syslog_vip
variables.description: RFC1918 syslog VIP used for R630 node log shipping.

stages.summary: Record the destructive install target contract before rebuilding pri or sec.
command: printf '%s\n' 'install Rocky Linux 10 on OS mirror only' 'preserve IDSDM EFI handoff' 'exclude SAS hot-swap bays from OS install' 'keep SOL enabled before and after rebuild' 'do not use ter dstore as an OS target' 'do not wipe ter'

stages.summary: Record the first-pass R630 Kolla network contract.
command: printf '%s\n' 'create bond0 on eno1+eno2 for management/API' 'create bond1 on eno3+eno4 for Neutron external/provider traffic with no host IP' 'leave ConnectX ports independent for RoCEv2 validation' 'do not promote ConnectX LACP before pairwise RDMA evidence' 'bond0 is network_interface/api_interface/kolla_external_vip_interface' 'bond1 is neutron_external_interface'

stages.summary: Record base services required before Kolla deployer admission.
command: printf '%s\n' 'install podman and Kolla host dependencies' 'enable chrony against RFC1918 time sources' 'enroll sssd/FreeIPA when the FreeIPA path is reachable' 'install node_exporter and Check_MK agent' 'ship rsyslog to the RFC1918 syslog VIP ${syslog_vip}' 'trust RFC1918 internal CA' 'validate AAA, NTP, telemetry, and logs before Kolla prechecks'

stages.summary: Run non-destructive Kolla Rocky 10 preflight against pri/sec; failure is expected until hosts are rebuilt to Rocky Linux 10.
Print the node-prep closeout criteria that must be true before Kolla bootstrap-servers.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Rocky Linux 10 installed on approved OS mirror devices' 'IDSDM EFI handoff preserved' 'SAS hot-swap bays excluded' 'bond0 and bond1 present with intended addressing' 'podman available' 'chrony synchronized' 'sssd/FreeIPA path validated or explicitly deferred' 'node_exporter and Check_MK agent active' 'rsyslog shipping to RFC1918 syslog VIP' 'RFC1918 internal CA trusted' 'fmt2-kolla-rocky10-preflight passed before kolla-ansible bootstrap-servers'
